scope: Bounded interpreter diagnostic on training programs. Survivors require review; unknowns are not passes.
selection: first 128 SHA-256 keys after student_rows._normalised(task, body=True)

reviewed_examples.name: move_first
reviewed_examples.interpretation: An extra output element is allowed despite the specified rotation.

reviewed_examples.name: findLUSlength
reviewed_examples.interpretation: The shorter of two unequal input lengths can satisfy the contract.

reviewed_examples.name: findShortestSubArray
reviewed_examples.interpretation: The contract bounds the result but does not determine the requested subarray length.

limits: Survivors may reflect intentional latitude; tied extrema are examples. Two timeouts are unknown. The audit is bounded and interpreter-based, not a formal proof or a causal explanation of the development regression.
